x: Heard a new member from the Royal Navy ran in good style and should be an asset to our teams when demobbed. The handicap was deservedly won by Ken Stimpson, with Alf Taylor second and Heard third.
Eddie Short was rather unlucky in just missing a place, he finished 4th in last year's race, and Mike Heard and Arthur Bruce both did well in such a large field.
Positions: 2, Burfitt, 43.2; 7, Blowfield, 44.3; 10, Stimpson; 15, Heard; 20, Frost; 31, Charlton; 46, McDonald; 53, Shields; 83, Smith; 85, K.

3rd Relay: 2nd, Charlton (B), 24.49; Brown (A), 24.51; Stimpson (C), 25.57; Walker (D), 27.5; Taylor (E), 26.35. 4th Relay: 3rd, Heard (B), 24.55; W. Lucas (A), 24.28; Porter (C), 25.38; Shields (E), 26.50.

Tom Carter is still showing useful form for an old 'un, and it is to the younger element such as Mike Heard, Len Adams, Bragginton, Popplewell and Ches Walker, that we look to for support in the more serious races to come.

The others followed at short intervals, Charlton 20th, Tobin 38th, Heard and Ken Stimpson 50th, MacDonald 60th and Housego 130th. The next time we saw them, which was about 5 miles, Ferguson had opened up a gap between Field and Thompson; our runners were round about the same as before.
